item.title: Updating error
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
Morphing a template from Debian to Kicksecure will add the fasttrack repo. Debian doesn’t come with fasttrack enabled by default, Kicksecure turns it on. That works fine when fasttrack is maintained, but it seems upstream isn’t maintaining it as well as would be hoped…
